messages.subject: App Works locally but not when published (succesfully) in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi all,

Kind of a newbie here,

I made my first app which basically gets some data from a googlesheet i have published and outputs a datatable based on some R code.

It all works perfectly locally and publishes succesfully when i hit publish but then when the browser pops i get this error:

ERROR: Expected content-type:
text/csv
Actual content-type:
text/html; charset=UTF-8

how can this be solved? thanks in advance.

here is my server.R and ui.R and deploy log

library(shiny)
library(googlesheets)


my_key <- "1xwKXLp3Hsn3vrxUw5gudHh_8-fTj9veT5BL2c9EAD-Y"
my_ss <- gs_key(my_key)
my_data <- gs_read(my_ss)



shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$update,{  
    isolate ({
        
      my_data$c2 <-ifelse(my_data$anergoianaenego>input$c2+18.7,1,0)
      my_data$c2p <- ifelse(my_data$c2 >0,my_data$anergoianaenego-input$c2-18.7,0)
          
      my_data$c3 <-ifelse(my_data$makroxronia2015>input$c3+56.6,1,0)
      my_data$c3p <- ifelse(my_data$c3 >0,my_data$makroxronia2015-input$c3-56.6,0)
          
      my_data$c4 <-ifelse(my_data$metabolhmakroxronias>input$c4+16.9,1,0)
      my_data$c4p <- ifelse(my_data$c4 >0,my_data$metabolhmakroxronias-input$c4-16.9,0)
      
      my_data$pteliko<-my_data$c2p +my_data$c3p    
      
      x<-nrow(my_data)
      my_data$c6<- 0
      
      for (i in 1:x){
        if(input$c5==1){
          if(my_data$c2[i]>0 && my_data$c3[i]>0){
            my_data$c6[i] <-1
          }
          if(my_data$c6[i]>0){
            my_data$pteliko[i]<-my_data$pteliko[i]+my_data$c4p[i]
          }
        }
        if(input$c5==2){
          if(my_data$c2[i]>0 || my_data$c3[i]>0){
            my_data$c6[i] <-1
          }
          if(my_data$c6[i]>0){
            my_data$pteliko[i]<-my_data$pteliko[i]+my_data$c4p[i]
          }
        }
        if(input$c5==3){
          
          my_data$c6[i] <-1
          
          if(my_data$c6[i]>0){
            my_data$pteliko[i]<-my_data$pteliko[i]+my_data$c4p[i]
          }
        }
      }  
          
      if (input$periferia != "Όλες") {
       my_data <- subset(my_data, periferia == input$periferia)
      }
      if (input$freq != "0"){
        my_data <-subset(my_data,anergoiover122015 >= input$freq)
      }
      
    })
    my_data<- my_data[,input$show_vars,drop=FALSE]
    
    my_data <- my_data[order(-my_data$pteliko),]
    
    output$table <- DT::renderDataTable({
      my_data}, options= list(
        autoWidth = TRUE,
        lengthMenu= c(10 , 30 ,50 , 100 , 200 , 300, 350),
        pageLength= 350,
        initComplete = DT::JS(
          "function(settings, json) {",
          "$(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color': '#000', 'color': '#fff'});",
          "}"),
        columnDefs= list(list(targets ="_all", width = '10px'))
        ))
  })
})

      column(4,

             ),
      column(4,
             numericInput("c2", label ="Κριτήριο 2",min = 0, max= 100, value = 3),
             numericInput("c3", label ="Κριτήριο 3",min = 0, max= 100, value = 3),

             actionButton("update", "Πατήστε για Υπολογισμό Σεναρίου")
             )
    ),
    fluidRow(
    # Create a new row for the table.
    isolate({fluidRow(
      column(7,
        DT::dataTableOutput("table")
      )

    )
)

Nikos,
I confirmed with our engineering team and it looks like the IDE isn't providing an option to upload the .httr-oauth file.  I would love it if you could try deploying the application by running:

rsconnect::deployApp() 

I am hoping that this will be an acceptable work around until we fix the IDE.

-Tareef
